choices.reason: The paper does not uniquely designate either Study 2 contrast as primary; its abstract and introduction highlight the disappearance of the creativity deficit under co-creation as Study 2's main result. This identifies the co-creator-versus-human contrast under rule 2, while the highlighted editor-versus-human finding is explicitly attributed to Study 1.
choices.locator: PDF p. 1, abstract, sentence beginning 'Following this'; also PDF p. 2, final introduction paragraph before Results.
choices.quote: Following this, we demonstrate that this creativity deficit dissipates when people co-create with—not edit—AI and establish creative self-efficacy as an important mechanism in this process (Study 2).
